design.side_block: metal state (4) + coordination (22) + metal one-hot (5) + cell one-hot (top-40); numeric part standardised on the whole cohort, one-hots untouched
design.evaluation: msrs_surface_model.score on fold_id >= 0 rows, same as every other DOI artifact

kill.rule: D-MPNN mean R^2 < 0.3767 closes the representation line

caveats: The D-MPNN sees strictly more information than the fingerprint arm: the graph replaces ECFP4/MACCS/RDKit and the side block adds metal and cell identity that the tree also has. A win is a representation win, not a controlled ablation of graph-vs-fingerprint alone.
Epochs are fixed at 40 with no early stopping. An early-stopping split inside the training folds would either leak a DOI or need a nested split, and a fixed budget keeps the seeds comparable.

The numeric side block is standardised on the whole cohort rather than per fold. It is label-free, so this is transductive preprocessing, not leakage, but it does mean the fold is not fully self-contained.
The seed-averaged R^2 is the number 0.3767 is quoted against; the per-seed mean is what one training run delivers. They differ by about 0.01 on the tree and the gate reads the seed-averaged one.
